description: Class representing a single AutoFilter column.

GetCriteria1.description: Returns the first criteria associated with the filter for this column.

returns.description: The first criteria for the filter.

GetCriteria1.signature: GetCriteria1(): string | string[] | number | XlDynamicFilterCriteria | null

GetCriteria2.description: Returns the second criteria associated with the filter for this column.

returns.description: The second criteria for the filter, or null if not applicable.

GetOn.description:
Indicates whether any filter is applied on this column.

The property is true when at least one of the following underlying
structures is present for the column:
- Filters
- CustomFiltersObj
- DynamicFilter
- ColorFilter
- Top10

returns.description: True if a filter is applied; otherwise, false.

GetOperator.description: Returns the operator used for the filter on this column.

returns.description: The operator for the current filter.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent filters collection for this filter column.
